# ElectroPuppet

> > ElectroPuppet is a creative studio specializing in Adobe Character Animator puppets, animation services, and visual effects, led by writer-director Philip Smith.

The studio offers professional animation production, custom rigged characters with lip-sync and walk capabilities, and educational resources for Character Animator. ElectroPuppet is known for their Walk & Talk series and provides free puppets to help animators get started.

## Key Topics

- Adobe Character Animator
- Philip Smith
- Character rigging and lip-sync
- Walk-enabled puppets
- Free Dudley puppet
- Animation services
- Visual effects production
- Writer-director
- AFTRS (Australian Film Television & Radio School)

- Animation puppets
- Producer
